name: Stage 50:1: Frillingmossen, etapp 50 to Sjön Björken, etapp 54
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 50:1, Frillingmossen, etapp 50 to Sjön Björken, etapp 54.
utilities: Official area: Nyköpings kommun, Nynäs, Trosa kommun.
This is a branch connector between stage 50 at Frillingmossen and stage 54 at sjön Björken; it is part of the Nynäs Runt loop, not a continuation from Bråfalls såg.

Bråfalls såg is nearby start/access context within about 0.4-0.9 km of the connector, with parking, rest shelter, toilet, bus, and sparse waste/fireplace caveats. Månbacken is nearby end/access context about 1.1-1.4 km from the connector endpoint, with parking/bus/toilet and booked lodging.
Björken has a shelter/fireplace/toilet/bathing area on stage 54 about 0.4 km from the 50:1 endpoint. No shop, cafe, or verified drinking-water tap was found on the connector itself.
waterSources: No reliable drinking-water source was found on 50:1. Carry water from Bälinge/Tystberga/Nynäs or other planned services.

Stora Frillingen, Lilla Frillingen, and Björken are natural lake water only; treat/filter/boil if used and avoid moving untreated water or wet gear between lakes because of crayfish-plague precautions in the Björken area.

Månbackestugorna should not be treated as a water source; hiker/lodging context says guests should bring drinking water. The nearest later official tap in this part of the system is the stage-54 pump near Gisekvarn, far beyond Björken and with quality caveats.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official and Naturkartan distance is 4 km. The local drawn line is about 3.5 km because it starts at the official Frillingmossen fork and runs to Björken; Naturkartan's roughly 4.0 km geometry starts from Bråfalls-side access context. Keep 4 km for planning.

OSM relation 9627989 is the correct 50:1 relation and measures about 3.56 km from Frillingmossen to the Stage 54 corridor near Sjön Björken. Do not model 50:1 as starting at Bråfalls såg, even though Bråfalls is a useful nearby access node.

Light forest connector through Frillingön between two wetland/myr areas and the lakes Stora and Lilla Frillingen, then toward sjön Björken. Hiker reports describe it as one of the prettier short links in this area, with mossy forest, rock, lake views, and useful Nynäs Runt loop-building value.

The official page still shows a fault notice: the temporary reroute remains current because bark-beetle damage makes trees fall easily, especially from the Frillingen guestbook pulpit toward the reroute. Follow orange tape and posted reroute maps on site, and avoid lingering under dead spruce, especially in wind.

Naturkartan publishes a separate temporary-reroute object for 50:1, about 1.0 km long, starting near 58.846847,17.364865 and rejoining near 58.853438,17.372180. The reroute start is on the stored 50:1 line, but the rejoin is about 0.5 km east of the stored 50:1/Björken connector and snaps near Stage 54; show it as active alternate/hazard geometry rather than pretending the stored line is current all the way.

A 2024 user comment on Månbacken runt said the northern part of 50:1 was barely passable but that an alternative route existed. Treat this as anecdotal support for taking the official reroute seriously.

A midpoint rest cliff by Stora Frillingen has a guestbook pulpit. Official steward notes and a 2020 hiker report also mention a wild-boar wallow/spa mid-stage; treat it as wildlife habitat, not an attraction to enter.

The route is in/near Nynäs nature reserve. Reserve rules restrict overnighting to designated places and fires/grilling to reserve-managed fireplaces with provided wood; do not assume wild camping or informal fires are allowed. Fishing is prohibited in Stora Frillingen, Lilla Frillingen, Björken, and Gisesjön inside the reserve, and wet gear should be cleaned/dried/disinfected before moving between lakes because of crayfish-plague risk.

facilities.name: Frillingmossen / stage 50:1 start
facilities.description: Official stage 50:1 start at the branch from stage 50. Main stage 50 continues toward Bråfalls såg; 50:1 heads toward Björken/stage 54.

facilities.name: Stage 50 / 50:1 fork
facilities.description: Route-builder junction at/near Frillingmossen: select 50:1 only when connecting toward Björken/stage 54 instead of continuing main stage 50 to Bråfalls såg.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg nearby start access
facilities.description: Near, but not on the forward 50:1 line: picnic/rest shelter, toilet, parking and bus context at Bråfalls såg.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg bus stop
facilities.description: Mapped bus stop east of Bråfalls såg, useful for access to the 50/50:1 fork with extra walking. Verify live departures.

facilities.name: Stora Frillingen rest cliff and guestbook
facilities.description: Official midpoint rest cliff with lake view and guestbook pulpit. Approximate pin derived from route geometry; this is also the start-side context for the bark-beetle/falling-tree warning zone.

facilities.name: Stora Frillingen lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water only; not a verified potable source. Treat/filter if used.

facilities.name: Lilla Frillingen lake water
facilities.description: Natural lake water context beside the connector corridor; not a potable tap.

facilities.name: Temporary reroute start near Stora Frillingen
facilities.description: Naturkartan maps the current temporary 50:1 reroute starting near here. Follow orange tape and posted map signs; this marker is a reroute context point, not the whole alternate line.

facilities.name: Bark-beetle reroute / falling-tree warning
facilities.description: Official fault notice updated 2024-04-17 says the temporary reroute remains current and that dead spruce after bark-beetle damage can fall easily, especially from the Frillingen guestbook pulpit toward the reroute. Follow orange tape and posted maps; walked distance and topology may differ from the drawn base line.

facilities.name: Northern 50:1 passability warning
facilities.description: A 2024 official-loop comment said the northern part of 50:1 was barely passable, with an alternative route thankfully available. Anecdotal but consistent with the active reroute/falling-tree warning.

facilities.name: Temporary reroute rejoins Stage 54
facilities.description: Naturkartan's temporary 50:1 reroute line rejoins Stage 54 near here, about 0.5 km east of the stored Björken connector and about 0.6 km before that connector along Stage 54. Follow current signs.

facilities.name: Dead spruce near 50:1 end
facilities.description: Official warning says the end-side area is severely affected by bark-beetle-killed spruce. Do not linger under dead trees and avoid this corridor in strong wind.

facilities.name: Wild-boar wallow context
facilities.description: Official steward tip and a 2020 hiker report mention a wild-boar wallow/spa mid-stage. Observe from the trail and give wildlife space.

facilities.name: Björken / stage 54 connection
facilities.description: Stored Stage 50:1 endpoint where the base connector joins the stage 54 corridor near sjön Björken. This is a Stage 54 connector point, not the Björken shelter itself.

facilities.name: Björken shelter
facilities.description: Official stage 54 shelter by sjön Björken, close to the 50:1 end; shared, first-come shelter.

facilities.name: Björken fireplace
facilities.description: Official stage 54 text lists a prepared fireplace at the Björken shelter and a masonry fireplace on the nearby rock. Use only if reserve rules and current fire risk allow.

facilities.name: Björken toilet caveat
facilities.description: OSM/third-party sources map or mention a toilet near the Björken shelter area, but the current official Stage 54 text clearly lists toilets at Månbacken and Gisesjön rather than explicitly at Björken. Verify on site.

facilities.name: Björken lake water / bathing
facilities.description: Lake water only. Stage 54 notes good bathing but also warns to read crayfish-plague information so it is not spread via wet gear between lakes.

facilities.name: Björken / Frillingen fishing ban
facilities.description: Within Nynäs reserve, fishing is prohibited in Björken, Stora Frillingen, Lilla Frillingen, and Gisesjön. Do not launch boats or fish from floating craft in reserve lakes/watercourses. Check exact reserve boundaries and posted signs.

facilities.name: Crayfish-plague water biosecurity
facilities.description: Clean, dry, or disinfect boots, fishing gear, boats, packrafts and other wet equipment before moving between lakes. Crayfish plague can spread via water and wet gear.

facilities.name: Månbacken parking
facilities.description: Official 50:1 text says parking is available at Månbacken near the endpoint. This is not directly on the connector; verify signs.

facilities.name: Månbacken bus stop
facilities.description: Official access option: bus to Månbacken, then walk to the stage. It also connects to Vagnhärad by bus per official text; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Månbacken toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet near Månbacken/Björken context; stage 54 also notes toilet at Månbacken. Verify season/access.

facilities.name: Månbacken cottages / Nynäs lodging context
facilities.description: Stage 54 and Nynäs reserve material describe simple Månbacken cottages/lodging booked via Nynäs slott. Book ahead; not a free shelter and guests should bring drinking water.

facilities.name: Månbacken road barrier
facilities.description: Nynäs visitor material notes a road barrier blocking access toward Björken/Månbacken cottages and the shelter; walk the final section and do not drive beyond permitted access.

facilities.name: Karlfors/Månbacken access
facilities.description: Common road access for the Björken/Månbacken loop with parking/rest-hut context and bus nearby, about 1 km from Månbacken cabins. Useful for logistics, not on the 50:1 connector itself.

facilities.name: Gisekvarn pump distant water
facilities.description: Current official Stage 54 lists a pump at Gisekvarn fritidshusområde/Kvannestigen. This is far east on Stage 54, not Stage 50:1; do not rely on it for this connector unless your route continues there.

facilities.name: Brevik/Sandvik camping rule update
facilities.description: Nynäs current overnighting info says tenting is limited to designated grass areas at Brevik during renovation from 2026-03-16, max one night; otherwise use Sandviks camping where open. This is loop planning context, not on 50:1.

facilities.name: Gisesjön shelter burned-down notice
facilities.description: Nynäs current news lists a burned-down shelter at Gisesjön. This affects nearby Stage 54/Nynäs loop planning, not the 50:1 connector itself.

facilities.name: Nynäs reserve camping/fire rules
facilities.description: In Nynäs reserve, overnighting is limited to designated places and fires/grilling to managed fireplaces with provided wood. Do not damage dead or living wood; cycling is restricted to roads/gravel roads. Follow posted local rules.
